entry.idea: Small businesses often struggle to find affordable, flexible health insurance for their staff, so Angle Health sells a modern, digital 'level-funded' health plan built for them.
entry.lesson: Take a huge, regulated, old-fashioned market like health insurance and win the slice big insurers serve worst by being the modern, easy-to-use option.
entry.name: Angle Health

growth.reason: Funding rounds have climbed sharply ($58M, then $134M, then $600M) alongside a jump to a $2.7B valuation, and the company reports 5,000 customers and profitability.

market.reason: Health insurance is one of the biggest markets there is, though Angle Health currently only sells to small businesses in the United States.

tech.reason: Running a full digital insurance carrier with 100+ payroll integrations is solid, hard-won infrastructure, but not protected by unique science that others can't copy.

Angle Health - The Modern Level-Funded Health Plan

entry.twist: It runs its own AI-enabled insurance operations and plugs into more than 100 payroll and HR systems, so employers can manage benefits without the usual paperwork.
entry.who_pays: Employers pay premiums to enroll their employees in an Angle Health plan.
entry.why_now: Rising health costs are pushing small employers to look for cheaper, easier alternatives to traditional group health insurance.
